pricing_context_token.purpose: Immutable handoff object from Estimator to Reservation. Reservation must consume this token — it must NEVER recalculate price using legacy logic.

fields.inputs_hash: SHA-256 of inputs object used for engine call
fields.signature_future: HMAC or JWT — not implemented in V1

reservation_rules: Reservation MUST use final_amount_mad from token as booking price
Reservation MUST NOT recalculate using reservation.js SERVICE_PRICING
Reservation MUST NOT recalculate using reservation-v2.js SVC_PRICING_FB
Reservation MUST display parts_notice if variable_part_separate=true
Token expiry policy: TBD — recommend 30-minute session validity

session_contract.session_id: string — UUID v4 or deterministic from inputs
session_contract.qualification_status: PENDING | ELIGIBLE | INELIGIBLE | SAFETY_STOP | ROUTE_REQUIRED | REQUALIFY | QUOTE_REQUIRED

state_persistence.rationale: Simple flows complete in <2 minutes. No long-lived state needed. URL params support deep-linking and back navigation.
state_persistence.session_storage: Acceptable for complex flows (painting measurement assistant, multi-step quote)
state_persistence.local_storage: NOT RECOMMENDED for pricing state — sensitive, may persist stale prices
state_persistence.server_token: FUTURE — required when pricing token needs server-side validation before reservation
state_persistence.no_sensitive_data_in_url: session_id in URL is fine, full pricing data should not be in URL querystring
